company.name: SATS ASA
company.summary: Sats ASA provides fitness and training services in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and Finland. It offers sportswear, fitness gear, bars, and energy drinks. The company operates fitness clubs under the SATS, ELIXIA, Fresh Fitness, and SATSYoga brand names. Sats ASA was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

narrative.company_subtitle: SATS ASA – Fitness & well-being in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland
narrative.company_headline: 10.5% revenue CAGR, 16.7% EBITDA margin and 1.1x net debt/EBITDA — market cap NOK 8.5bn
highlights: **Consistent growth:** revenue compounded at 10.5% p.a. over 2022–2025, reaching NOK 5,509m
**Margin profile:** pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA margin of 16.7% in 2025A (up from 2.2% in 2022A), EBIT margin 12.7%
**Cash generative:** unlevered FCF of NOK 518m in 2025A, 56% of EBITDA, ROIC 18%
**Balance sheet:** net debt of NOK 1,077m equals 1.1x EBITDA, a conservative leverage level
narrative.market_subtitle: SATS versus its peer group: growth, profitability and the drivers behind the case
narrative.market_headline: Peer benchmarking on a consistent basis
opportunities: Proven ability to **raise prices above CPI** through product tiers
Continued **ARPM growth** from dynamic pricing and premium concept roll-outs
Structural under-penetration versus the US (9% vs 24%) leaves a long runway
disruption: Countering boutique studios by **integrating high-end concepts** inside existing clubs
**SATS App** and online training act as retention tools
threats: **Macro headwinds**: prolonged high interest rates could pressure disposable income
**Aggressive low-cost competition** could limit pricing flexibility
financial_commentary: **SATS grew revenue by 8.8% in 2025A** to NOK 5,509m, with pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA of NOK 922m (16.7% margin)

**2026E is built on the 2 reported quarters:** revenue +4.9% year-to-date at a 16.7% EBITDA margin (17.0% a year earlier); the rest of the year at +3.8% growth on last year's seasonal margins gives NOK 5,751m (+4.4%) and a 16.4% margin; growth then follows consensus (5 analysts) and fades to 1.5% by 2031E
**EBITDA margin path:** 16.4% in 2026E to 18.0% in 2031E; D&A 4.5% and capex 4.9% of revenue; tax rate 22%
**Unlevered FCF** rises from NOK 546m to NOK 725m over the forecast period (10.5% FCF margin in 2031E)
**Valuation vs peers:** SATS trades at 10.2x LTM EV/EBITDA versus a peer median of 11.2x (-9%) and 16.8x P/E versus 19.4x
**Street view:** consensus target of NOK 51.80 across 5 analysts (+18% vs current price)
narrative.valuation_subtitle: We recommend a HOLD. Our 12-month target price of NOK 47.50 implies +8% upside and a +11% total return including dividend; 10.1x 2026E EV/EBITDA.
narrative.valuation_headline: DCF fair value NOK 44.66, peer multiples NOK 50.66, scenario-weighted NOK 46.22 versus a share price of NOK 43.95 — HOLD
market_implied: **Market-implied WACC 8.6%**, in line with our 8.5%: the price discounts our cash flows at 10bp more than we do
**Market-implied margin:** at our WACC the price is consistent with a 2031E EBITDA margin of 17.8% versus 18.0% in our base case
scenario_commentary: **Bear (25%):** Low-cost competition caps price increases and member growth stalls; revenue CAGR 1.8%, 2031E margin 16.0%, WACC 9.0% gives NOK 28.38 (-35% vs price)
**Base (50%):** Consensus growth; margin expands to 18% on operating leverage; revenue CAGR 3.8%, 2031E margin 18.0%, WACC 8.5% gives NOK 44.66 (+2% vs price)
**Bull (25%):** Premium concepts lift ARPM faster and club utilisation normalises; revenue CAGR 5.8%, 2031E margin 20.0%, WACC 8.0% gives NOK 67.18 (+53% vs price)
thesis: **DCF value of NOK 44.66 per share** (WACC 8.5%, terminal growth 1.5%); terminal value is 71% of EV, implying 8.5x exit EV/EBITDA
**Peer multiples imply NOK 50.66** per share (median of EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT and P/E-based values)
**Scenarios:** bear NOK 28 / base NOK 45 / bull NOK 67; probability-weighted NOK 46.22
**12-month target price NOK 47.50:** fair value NOK 44.66 (valued at 23.09.2026) rolled forward at the 9.2% cost of equity less NOK 1.44 dividend; expected total return +11%, rating HOLD
multiples_commentary: **Trading at a discount:** 10.2x EV/EBITDA vs 11.2x peer median (9% discount)
**Earnings multiple:** 16.8x trailing P/E vs 19.4x for peers (-13%); 13.0x vs 15.7x on next-twelve-month consensus
**Versus own history:** 10.7x trailing EV/EBITDA is above the 2.5-year median of 10.2x (70% of weeks were cheaper)
**EV/EBITDA-implied value:** NOK 48.69 at the peer median of 11.2x (range 44–53 across the 25th–75th percentile)
risks: **Value drivers:** EBITDA margin ±1pp moves fair value to NOK 40.9–48.4, WACC ±0.5pp to NOK 41.3–48.5 (base NOK 44.66)
**Execution:** the case assumes 4.4% growth in 2026E and margins of 18.0% by 2031E; a return to the 2022–2025 average margin of 12.4% would cut fair value
**Macro:** consumer spending, interest rates and FX can move revenue and the discount rate simultaneously
consensus: **EPS 2026E NOK 2.44 vs consensus NOK 2.94 (-17%):** we are below the 5 analysts – outside the range of estimates; 2027E -24%; our view rests on a 16.4% 2026E EBITDA margin and a 22% tax rate
**Revenue 2026E NOK 5,751m vs consensus NOK 5,721m (+0.5%):** in line by construction – our growth is anchored on consensus, so the differentiated view sits in margins
**Estimate momentum positive:** consensus EPS over the last 90 days 2026E +3.5%, 2027E +5.0%; 9 upward and 1 downward revisions in the last 30 days
multiples_depth: **On next-twelve-month consensus** SATS trades at 13.0x P/E (peers 15.7x), 1.6x EV/Sales (peers 1.7x), 9.6x EV/EBITDA at the LTM margin (peers 10.4x); PEG 0.64 vs 1.05

**Growth and margin explain 6% of the dispersion in peer EV/EBITDA** (10 peers): fundamentals justify 11.4x against the 11.2x median (+2%); the actual 10.2x leaves -10% unexplained. Evidence weak: multiples in this group are set by something the regression does not see – leverage, geography, liquidity or the cycle
**Cash and payout:** 9.2% levered FCF yield vs 5.2% for peers; 3.3% dividend yield vs 4.2%
**Consensus EPS growth FY1:** +20% for SATS vs +16% for the peer median – the growth the forward multiple is buying
